about:
Veteran Wood Co. operates from Fairfield in Morris County, New Jersey, as a veteran-owned business founded by Michael, a Marine veteran. The company began with a focus on craftsmanship and dedication, producing handcrafted custom products for homes and offices.

The shop produces custom 3D signs, artistic woodwork, and cabinetry through two sub-brands: Royal Oak Designs for custom cabinetry and Shift Haus Signs for automotive signage. Capabilities include LED channel letters, large-format exterior signs, memorial artwork, and CNC machining using Stepcraft equipment. The company also offers paid training sessions in Vetric design software and Stepcraft CNC operation.

Clients span government and military agencies — including the U.S. Marshals Service, NSA headquarters, Marine Corps bases, and U.S. Capitol Police — as well as veterans organizations such as the VFW, cannabis dispensaries, salons, and general commercial businesses. Projects have ranged from office badge signs and base signage to memorial pieces and retail storefronts.

The company emphasizes its veteran-owned status and American-made production, offering worldwide shipping that includes APO and DPO military addresses. Standard lead times run six to eight weeks, with rush service available for a fee.
